title: DNI issued memo
summary: The DNI sent a threat memo to the Secretary of State.
line: The Director of National Intelligence oversees and coordinates the work of U.S. intelligence agencies.

title: Lula wins runoff
line: A runoff is a second election held between the top two candidates when neither wins a majority in the first round.

title: Lula wins fourth term
summary: Lula became the first candidate to reverse a first-round defeat.
line: Lula finished first in the initial round but faced a runoff against Flávio Bolsonaro.

title: Level-funded health plans attract employers
summary: Small businesses are considering level-funded plans.
line: Level-funded health plans allow employers to pay only actual claims rather than fixed premiums, reducing upfront costs.

title: Players consider LIV Golf
summary: Players are discussing a rival golf league.
line: Players who join LIV Golf must leave the PGA Tour.

title: Zoroastrian burial practice discussed
summary: A case raised questions about burial rites.
line: Zoroastrianism traditionally exposed the dead to fire as part of burial rites.

title: Brazil runoff voting
line: In Brazil, the Supreme Court manages election procedures.

title: Bond yields rise by 25 basis points
line: basis points: A unit equal to one hundredth of a percentage point.
